profile.name: Abin Khungur Ganlary
profile.headline: Operations & Finance professional · Builds apps, web tools & automation with AI
profile.summary: 8+ years running administration, finance and procurement for international research and donor-funded organisations, and I build the software that makes that work faster. Using AI assistants, I've shipped a desktop finance app, iOS apps, web apps, Excel/VBA automation and Power BI dashboards. I care about clean books, smooth operations and tools people actually use.

experience.org: ICRISAT (International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics)
experience.bullets:
Run the Delhi office cash book, banking and month-end close; send monthly finance summaries with variance analysis and risk flags to HQ.
Support donor compliance for World Bank, FAO and Gates Foundation funded projects.
Designed and built ICRISAT CashBook, a desktop finance app (cash book, bank reconciliation, vendor bills, petty cash vouchers, multi-PC LAN sync) using AI-assisted development tools; shipped six tested releases.
Process purchase requests in NetSuite and ensure approved, timely vendor payments.
Manage fixed assets, logistics, vehicle logs, facilities and front office; supervise the office assistant and drivers.

Held alongside the Administrative Officer role at I-TECH India.
Contributed to Sankalak 6th Edition, India's national HIV reporting publication, launched on World AIDS Day 2024; listed as a Technical Support contributor.
Validated SOCH output data with the NACO Strategic Information Division.
Built Power BI dashboards and QGIS HIV-positivity maps at national and district level.

Supported project budgets of ₹3.34 Cr (FY2022) and ₹2.16 Cr (FY2023) at I-TECH India with the Finance Manager: Tally Prime entries, POs, vouchers, BRS, TDS tracking and month-end close.
Kept donor-wise records in QuickBooks and Excel, filed monthly donor expenditure reports and prepared audit files, achieving full compliance.
Drafted about 90% of procurement, staff and consultant contracts; ran vendor due diligence, AMCs, lease review and insurance.
Built Excel tools (Budget vs Actual tracker, leave tracker for 20+ staff, reimbursement forms); a new expense tracking system cut discrepancies by 15%.
Supported the M&E team on national HIV programme reporting with NACO: validated SOCH data, contributed to Sankalak 6th Edition (2024) and built QGIS district maps.
Supported Section 8 company and FCRA registration, including the designated SBI FCRA account.

Coordinated 100+ end-to-end travel requests, cutting processing errors by 25%.
Supported procurement and vendor management with a 15% cost reduction and 10% shorter lead times.
Organised logistics for 10+ high-impact events and 20+ meetings and workshops.
Managed office assets: issuance, movement, insurance, disposal and maintenance.
